name: RingCentral
description: RingCentral is a cloud communications platform providing business phone, team messaging, video meetings, and AI-powered customer engagement and contact center tools.
best_for: Businesses of all sizes, from small teams to Fortune 1000 enterprises, that need unified phone, video, messaging, and contact center capabilities in one platform.
features: Cloud-based business phone system (RingEX) with business SMS
AI Receptionist for automated call answering and routing
AIR Pro no-code custom AI agent builder
AI Virtual Assistant (AVA) for meeting notes and task automation
RingCX omnichannel contact center with AI-powered quality management
500+ third-party app integrations via open APIs

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: Per user/month, billed annually ($30/user/month billed monthly). Unlimited domestic calling, HD meetings for 300 participants.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.notes: Per user/month, billed annually ($35/user/month billed monthly). CRM integrations, multi-site support.

tiers.name: Ultra
tiers.notes: Per user/month, billed annually ($45/user/month billed monthly). RingCentral Webinar, unlimited storage.

alternatives.name: Zoom
alternatives.description: A video conferencing platform for meetings, webinars, and team chat used widely across businesses and education.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing reliable, widely adopted video conferencing

alternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
alternatives.description: A collaboration hub combining chat, video meetings, and file sharing tightly integrated with Microsoft 365.
strengths: Chat and video in one app

alternatives.name: Webex
alternatives.description: Cisco's AI-powered collaboration platform for video meetings, webinars, calling, and messaging.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting video, calling, and messaging with in-house AI transcription
